description: Fails-to-deliver history for one US-listed security from the SEC's CNS fails-to-deliver file, by ticker symbol. Returns each settlement date with the number of shares that failed to deliver, the closing price, the security description and its CUSIP. A fail-to-deliver is a settlement failure — shares not delivered on time — and the SEC states it is NOT evidence of naked short selling; ordinary causes include processing delays, order-entry errors and illiquidity. Answers "what were the fails-to-deliver for GME", "has this stock had settlement failures recently".

periods.description: How many recent half-month files to search, 1-6 (default 2, roughly the last month). SEC publishes one file per half month.

symbol.description: Ticker symbol as SEC writes it, e.g. "GME", "TSLA".
